method: independent standard-library parse of raw finished v5 records; no frozen postprocessor helper used
run_role: new matched-initialization single-seed intervention, not archived replay
initial_tensor_digest_boundary: Cross-arm recorded tensor digests checked against pinned source generation algorithm; no initial LoRA tensors were saved for local rehash.
weights_binding: Pinned v5 source verified the four actual Colab base shard hashes against the immutable accepted identity; local original four-shard SHA recheck is attached separately.
reference_timing: tag0 is frozen SFT adapter-disabled measurement after update6, not actual t0 observation
actual_token_decoder: Pinned tokenizer ByteLevel inverse vocabulary; every recorded completion decoded and stripped independently equals its logged raw text
gradient_formula: for each prompt group: dL/dz_local=-(sum_{firsttoken=local} A_i/T_i - p_local(training_context)*sum_all A_i/T_i)/(16*1.3), direct task term only
gradient_limits: Training-context raw logits were not saved; no panel probability was substituted into the training-context formula.
Intervals use p_local in [0,1]; they are direct first-token task-loss derivatives, not full parameter gradients, KL, clipping or Adam updates.
Counterfactual fixed T7 first-token coefficient is a normalization comparison, not an executed training arm.
A/T uses source-reconstructed float32 advantages and actual recorded mask lengths; floating arithmetic and model Jacobians are not reproduced.
interpretation: top_p1 alone did not restore greedy local choices on this fixed panel after6; this rejects top-p truncation as the sole sufficient explanation in this bounded experiment.

The particular balanced-prefix replacement strongly shifts canonical-local mass and switches all16 panel greedy answers to local; it restores8 local-optimal hits and creates8 wrong local answers on offload-optimal panel states.
The balanced prefix changes12 concrete training contexts and correlated server/cost features; this does not isolate an abstract class-prior parameter or establish a general training fix.
Only after6 is a three-arm comparison; after7 has baseline and balanced only.
No additional model inference, GPU or training was run by this independent check.

length_normalization_facts.observed_local_completion_lengths: Every local-action completion in all three arms had actual mask length3 including EOS.
length_normalization_facts.scope: The factor applies equally to positive and negative local advantages; it is not an observed full-model probability-change multiplier.

summed_derivative_scope: Sum of direct first-token task-loss derivatives across training contexts, equivalently a virtual shared first-position local-logit shift; not an actual shared model parameter gradient.
raw_record_verification_limits: Initial A and RNG digests are cross-checked recorded GPU evidence, not locally rehashed initial tensors; raw probability means are recomputed from recorded rows, while top-p support/renormalization was independently reconstructed for all128 records using full-support equality or a complete nucleus contained in top5.
